                                      1 
                               V. NEW BUSINESS 
                                        
                                        
                                        
Town Clerk: 
 
A. AUTHORIZE    THE  MAYOR,,   BARBARA   C. SMYTH,   TO  EXECUTE   A  THREE 
(3) YEAR  AGREEMENT WITH      . INFO QUICK   SOLUTIONS,   INC. FOR  THE  4499 
– INTEGRATED    LAND  RECORDS    AND  VITAL STATISTICS RECORDING SYSTEM 
                    FOR 3 YEARS   FOR $62,400 PER YEAR. 
ACCOUNT GEN FUND TC IT SERVICES 010500-5255 
 
Mr. McQuaid provided an overview of the agreement and said it is for the land recording record 
system which is the main system that is used in the Town Clerks office. There were four 
companies interviewed and felt Info Quick Solutions was the best one for the needs of Norwalk 
and were the most compatible with the current system. 
 
** MR. FRAYER MOVED TO APPROVE THE ITEM. 
** THE MOTION PASSED UNANIMOUSLY. 
                                        
B. AUTHORIZE    THE  TOWN    CLERK   OR  DESIGNEE    TO  ISSUE TWO   (2) ONE 
  (1) YEAR  CONTRACT EXTENSIONS ON THE INFO QUICK SOLUTIONS, INC. 
                      CONTRACT FOR $62,400 PER YEAR 
                                        
** MR. FRAYER MOVED TO APPROVE THE ITEM. 
** THE MOTION PASSED UNANIMOUSLY.

developing situations that occurred in the city. The priority was to deliver a thorough and
